scope: ZRG-25/ZRG-37 core thread-page state/action consumers; unexpanded toolbar and effective-provider boundaries explicitly retained.

facts.claim: Ac renders jc around Mc and supplied children. jc permits local-thread/client-local-thread, otherwise home navigation; Suspense has a named loading fallback. A route host different from selected host takes precedence and shows host loading before archived hydration. chatgpt.conversations capability controls a supplied handoff callback, not the general page rendering guard.
facts.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation

facts.claim: Mc effective archived-preview is route flag AND (selected archived atom OR imported Si); this is narrower than the raw flag used by jc to select fs. It suppresses site preview and selected normal-thread integrations, then passes the effective flag to lc. Do not collapse these two predicates.
facts.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation

facts.claim: Nc first rejects unsupported route kinds, then shows removed-host connection-unavailable when selected status is unavailable. It remembers id when a!=null AND c AND !l; c/l are named selected atom values, not evaluated here. For archived conversation outside effective preview, g!==id OR (c AND history status!==resumed) selects Ic; otherwise !c selects Fc. These conditions are not an unconditional archive redirect.
facts.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation

facts.claim: Ic queries !isConversationArchiving only when imported capability o is true; retry:false, stale/gc zero, no focus refetch. True result navigates to same location with archivedConversationPreview:true and replace; loading shows spinner. Otherwise Unarchive and open sets local pending and delegates selected manager unarchiveConversation(useAppServerPins). Rejection clears pending and shows danger; success callback does not itself navigate/reset pending.
facts.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation

facts.claim: Fc schedules replace navigation home with focusComposerNonce and an optional normalized project. The scheduling is source-only; project manager result and UI receipt are not proved.
facts.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation

facts.claim: fs archived hydration query is keyed by account/user/host/conversation/location key; staleTime Infinity, gcTime zero, retry false. Pending or fetching shows loading; only data===true renders children, all other settled values show Try again calling refetch. The query signal is not passed to hydrateArchivedThreadPreview; it gates error recovery. A matching persistent session, matching account key, nonaborted signal and qualified imported error predicate cause saved-preview clearing and same-location flag=false replacement; the original error is rethrown.
facts.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation

facts.claim: lc selects existing-conversation host or pending-client-thread host with local fallback. Effective archive preview passes shouldResume:false/isReadOnly:true, removes normal and overlay composer, uses local archive footer. Normal visibility/overlay conditions depend on explicit local panel flags; yj permits overlay only when chat pane is hidden and active tab lacks sidechat:, sidechat-loading:, background-agent: prefix. A mounted page alone does not prove content/composer visible.
facts.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation

facts.claim: xj forwards options to clientThreadId-keyed kj. kj derives W/K from route/pending state; passes a nonnull resume argument only when shouldResume, shared-background permission and host conditions allow. It consumes named cb resume state. Writer conflict makes content read-only, suppresses normal composer and supplies wj retry/fork footer; unavailable shows jj Retry. This is a UI consumer contract, not proof of cb transport or selected manager identity.
facts.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation

facts.claim: kj keeps initial missing-content and previously-seen-content disappearance distinct, attempts first-page hydration once per failed host/conversation key, and separately hydrates background threads. Depending on predicates it toasts not found, navigates to remembered parent or home; imported provider values remain unresolved. Resume failure/history loading/read-only/transcript visibility pass into dj rather than becoming a new turn submission.
facts.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation

facts.claim: dj history status ready/cached differs from error and local failed-history marker. Retry with status error reloads window; other warning Retry only clears local marker. Older history delegates loadOlderConversationHistoryPage, then waits lg; caught failure logs, conditionally records local failure and returns stop. Auto/user-scroll pagination is guarded by history-end, error, durable/resuming and visibility conditions. Scroll snapshot writes use named scoped TD, not evidence of disk persistence.
facts.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation

facts.claim: mr overlay composer disables submit when conversation missing, pending client thread, resume failed/unavailable/writer conflict; it presents retry/conflict UI with supplied callbacks. Local transcript branch is suppressed for failure/unavailable. wj fork is offered by eligibility; pending guards repeat calls, AbortController only suppresses navigation after result and aborts on teardown. Its signal is not passed to the fork delegate.
facts.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation

facts.claim: Removed-host unavailable UI navigates to /settings/connections. This is a repair entry, not automatic reconnection or deletion of the conversation.
facts.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation

facts.claim: Hn local archive footer optionally materializes cwd for nondurable host before manager unarchive. Success marks restoration, offers View now and invalidates archive query. Qualified imported error can still mark restored and show open-error; other failures clear restoration and toast. Local delete is offered only for local host, native threadArchive capability and matching selected preview, then requires confirmation. Delete result must include id; account/visit/location guards protect list update/navigation. This reuses existing archive/delete goals with different callbacks, not proven equivalent receiver identities.
facts.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation

facts.claim: ns defaults variant main; missing taskId navigates home. Main renders Zo; hotkey renders Co directly and registers title/environment/main-window path through Mi. The disabled Xe query observer uses FIVE_SECONDS staleTime and supplies error state; its declaration does not initiate a fetch. Settled error predicate is isFetchedAfterMount AND !isFetching AND error!=null.
facts.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation

facts.claim: ns inaccessible predicate adds error instanceof imported AFt identity and status===404. Ni then renders null even with cached task data, emits optional callback then info toast then replace-home once per keyed task instance. Non404 settled error without cached data renders Ai Retry calling selected task query refetch; cached data retains content. Callback does not await/catch refetch. Failure in an earlier unavailable effect step can prevent subsequent navigation.
facts.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation

facts.claim: Zo raw archived flag hides normal composer, overlay, panel-toggle and ordinary header actions, but supplies cloud preview footer. Overlay condition p&&m suppresses normal composer independently of archived status; overlay additionally requires nonarchived, task data and nonnull turn status. Co hotkey path bypasses these Zo archive/overlay restrictions and defaults showComposer:true. Product mode is not inferred from main/hotkey or local/remote.
facts.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation

facts.claim: Co selects focused assistant or current assistant. pending/in_progress sets working; failed shows Open in web banner. Composer requires showComposer and nonnull status. Task loading with no data shows spinner; data renders To while query error independently shows its message. Review apply banner additionally requires diff, task id, focused assistant id and detail-level condition. Header and error CTA use imported open-browser bridge with /tasks/id.
facts.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation

facts.claim: Co unread effect stores existing read timestamp or truncated creation-time milliseconds, then delegates mark-read mutation. It is an automatic mechanism rather than a separate user click. The named wo called by a diff effect is literally empty in this frozen program and declares no side effects; no diff notification is established.
facts.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation

facts.claim: To groups turns using imported grouping/focus helpers; empty groupings show loading. Nonempty groups render attachments, annotations, user text/comments and selected assistant. Only focused assistant receives fallbackDiff when code is not hidden. Search orchestration is remote:taskId keyed; bookmark attachment is absent while turnsLoading. Scrolling waits Wr and checks optional abort signal before DOM scroll; imported rendering/search authorities remain boundaries.
facts.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation

facts.claim: Cloud footer z awaits POST /wham/tasks/{task_id}/recover then updates selected archive state. Success supplies restored callback and View now, which clears selected preview and replaces location state:null. Failure clears restoration and toasts. Restoring/restored also derive from saved archive operation state. The generic noncloud branch uses another adapter; no server or disk result was observed.
facts.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation

facts.claim: ra and header da both consume local Program-bound Qi, not an imported Qi. Qi creates named Ct apply-patch mutation; if not pending and resolved root is truthy, it sends diff/cwd/operationSource:remote_conversation_apply_diff/revert. Apply/reapply use false, revert true. On returned status success it toggles named per-turn applied state; non-success result opens details; mutation rejection reports an error. ra/da disable actions when applying or !canApply. Root resolution, mutation receiver and real filesystem effects remain separate boundaries; no patch success or mode exclusion was observed.
facts.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation

命名委托的服务端结果、物理持久化、错误终态和重启恢复保留验证条件；本批不新增客户端运行或模型样例。

operations.userTrigger: 打开本地/待登记线程页
operations.conditionContract: 保留 jc/Nc 的分支优先级和有效归档条件。

operations.errorContract: 缺宿主进入连接修复；归档/缺内容/恢复失败各自呈现。
operations.cancellationContract: 离开不等于取消正在运行的 turn。
operations.recoveryContract: 上游路由、scoped状态、真实历史hydration/持久化另验。

operations.userTrigger: 不可用或写冲突 UI 的 Retry
operations.conditionContract: 不可用/冲突相应控件；冲突按钮在恢复/分支pending时禁用。
operations.stateOrRequestEndpoint: 调用提供的 retryResume；不新增 turn-start。
operations.errorContract: 命名 resume adapter 的错误状态通过原字段反馈。
operations.cancellationContract: fork本地abort只禁止晚到导航，未向服务传signal。
operations.recoveryContract: 重试能否重新取得writer需实际provider证据。

operations.inputContract: 账户/用户/宿主/线程/location key
operations.stateOrRequestEndpoint: refetch 同一命名查询；成功===true才渲染子内容。
operations.errorContract: 匹配session且特定错误才清preview并替换标志。
operations.cancellationContract: query signal仅约束错误恢复，未传hydration调用。
operations.recoveryContract: query无自动retry，gc0/staleInfinity；不声称后台停止。

operations.errorContract: 重载和局部清标记不得合并成统一服务重试。
operations.recoveryContract: 重载后真实上下文恢复未观察。

operations.userTrigger: 滚动到顶部请求较早历史

evidence.claim: Ac renders jc around Mc and supplied children. jc permits local-thread/client-local-thread, otherwise home navigation; Suspense has a named loading fallback. A route host different from selected host takes precedence and shows host loading before archived hydration. chatgpt.conversations capability controls a supplied handoff callback, not the general page rendering guard.
evidence.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation

evidence.claim: Mc effective archived-preview is route flag AND (selected archived atom OR imported Si); this is narrower than the raw flag used by jc to select fs. It suppresses site preview and selected normal-thread integrations, then passes the effective flag to lc. Do not collapse these two predicates.
evidence.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation

evidence.claim: Nc first rejects unsupported route kinds, then shows removed-host connection-unavailable when selected status is unavailable. It remembers id when a!=null AND c AND !l; c/l are named selected atom values, not evaluated here. For archived conversation outside effective preview, g!==id OR (c AND history status!==resumed) selects Ic; otherwise !c selects Fc. These conditions are not an unconditional archive redirect.
evidence.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation

evidence.claim: Ic queries !isConversationArchiving only when imported capability o is true; retry:false, stale/gc zero, no focus refetch. True result navigates to same location with archivedConversationPreview:true and replace; loading shows spinner. Otherwise Unarchive and open sets local pending and delegates selected manager unarchiveConversation(useAppServerPins). Rejection clears pending and shows danger; success callback does not itself navigate/reset pending.
evidence.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation

evidence.claim: Fc schedules replace navigation home with focusComposerNonce and an optional normalized project. The scheduling is source-only; project manager result and UI receipt are not proved.
evidence.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation

evidence.claim: fs archived hydration query is keyed by account/user/host/conversation/location key; staleTime Infinity, gcTime zero, retry false. Pending or fetching shows loading; only data===true renders children, all other settled values show Try again calling refetch. The query signal is not passed to hydrateArchivedThreadPreview; it gates error recovery. A matching persistent session, matching account key, nonaborted signal and qualified imported error predicate cause saved-preview clearing and same-location flag=false replacement; the original error is rethrown.
evidence.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation

evidence.claim: lc selects existing-conversation host or pending-client-thread host with local fallback. Effective archive preview passes shouldResume:false/isReadOnly:true, removes normal and overlay composer, uses local archive footer. Normal visibility/overlay conditions depend on explicit local panel flags; yj permits overlay only when chat pane is hidden and active tab lacks sidechat:, sidechat-loading:, background-agent: prefix. A mounted page alone does not prove content/composer visible.
evidence.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation

evidence.claim: xj forwards options to clientThreadId-keyed kj. kj derives W/K from route/pending state; passes a nonnull resume argument only when shouldResume, shared-background permission and host conditions allow. It consumes named cb resume state. Writer conflict makes content read-only, suppresses normal composer and supplies wj retry/fork footer; unavailable shows jj Retry. This is a UI consumer contract, not proof of cb transport or selected manager identity.
evidence.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation

evidence.claim: kj keeps initial missing-content and previously-seen-content disappearance distinct, attempts first-page hydration once per failed host/conversation key, and separately hydrates background threads. Depending on predicates it toasts not found, navigates to remembered parent or home; imported provider values remain unresolved. Resume failure/history loading/read-only/transcript visibility pass into dj rather than becoming a new turn submission.
evidence.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation

evidence.claim: dj history status ready/cached differs from error and local failed-history marker. Retry with status error reloads window; other warning Retry only clears local marker. Older history delegates loadOlderConversationHistoryPage, then waits lg; caught failure logs, conditionally records local failure and returns stop. Auto/user-scroll pagination is guarded by history-end, error, durable/resuming and visibility conditions. Scroll snapshot writes use named scoped TD, not evidence of disk persistence.
evidence.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation

evidence.claim: mr overlay composer disables submit when conversation missing, pending client thread, resume failed/unavailable/writer conflict; it presents retry/conflict UI with supplied callbacks. Local transcript branch is suppressed for failure/unavailable. wj fork is offered by eligibility; pending guards repeat calls, AbortController only suppresses navigation after result and aborts on teardown. Its signal is not passed to the fork delegate.
evidence.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation

evidence.claim: Removed-host unavailable UI navigates to /settings/connections. This is a repair entry, not automatic reconnection or deletion of the conversation.
evidence.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation

evidence.claim: Hn local archive footer optionally materializes cwd for nondurable host before manager unarchive. Success marks restoration, offers View now and invalidates archive query. Qualified imported error can still mark restored and show open-error; other failures clear restoration and toast. Local delete is offered only for local host, native threadArchive capability and matching selected preview, then requires confirmation. Delete result must include id; account/visit/location guards protect list update/navigation. This reuses existing archive/delete goals with different callbacks, not proven equivalent receiver identities.
evidence.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation

evidence.claim: ns defaults variant main; missing taskId navigates home. Main renders Zo; hotkey renders Co directly and registers title/environment/main-window path through Mi. The disabled Xe query observer uses FIVE_SECONDS staleTime and supplies error state; its declaration does not initiate a fetch. Settled error predicate is isFetchedAfterMount AND !isFetching AND error!=null.
evidence.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation

evidence.claim: ns inaccessible predicate adds error instanceof imported AFt identity and status===404. Ni then renders null even with cached task data, emits optional callback then info toast then replace-home once per keyed task instance. Non404 settled error without cached data renders Ai Retry calling selected task query refetch; cached data retains content. Callback does not await/catch refetch. Failure in an earlier unavailable effect step can prevent subsequent navigation.
evidence.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation

evidence.claim: Zo raw archived flag hides normal composer, overlay, panel-toggle and ordinary header actions, but supplies cloud preview footer. Overlay condition p&&m suppresses normal composer independently of archived status; overlay additionally requires nonarchived, task data and nonnull turn status. Co hotkey path bypasses these Zo archive/overlay restrictions and defaults showComposer:true. Product mode is not inferred from main/hotkey or local/remote.
evidence.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation

evidence.claim: Co selects focused assistant or current assistant. pending/in_progress sets working; failed shows Open in web banner. Composer requires showComposer and nonnull status. Task loading with no data shows spinner; data renders To while query error independently shows its message. Review apply banner additionally requires diff, task id, focused assistant id and detail-level condition. Header and error CTA use imported open-browser bridge with /tasks/id.
evidence.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation

evidence.claim: Co unread effect stores existing read timestamp or truncated creation-time milliseconds, then delegates mark-read mutation. It is an automatic mechanism rather than a separate user click. The named wo called by a diff effect is literally empty in this frozen program and declares no side effects; no diff notification is established.
evidence.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation

evidence.claim: To groups turns using imported grouping/focus helpers; empty groupings show loading. Nonempty groups render attachments, annotations, user text/comments and selected assistant. Only focused assistant receives fallbackDiff when code is not hidden. Search orchestration is remote:taskId keyed; bookmark attachment is absent while turnsLoading. Scrolling waits Wr and checks optional abort signal before DOM scroll; imported rendering/search authorities remain boundaries.
evidence.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation

evidence.claim: Cloud footer z awaits POST /wham/tasks/{task_id}/recover then updates selected archive state. Success supplies restored callback and View now, which clears selected preview and replaces location state:null. Failure clears restoration and toasts. Restoring/restored also derive from saved archive operation state. The generic noncloud branch uses another adapter; no server or disk result was observed.
evidence.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation

evidence.claim: ra and header da both consume local Program-bound Qi, not an imported Qi. Qi creates named Ct apply-patch mutation; if not pending and resolved root is truthy, it sends diff/cwd/operationSource:remote_conversation_apply_diff/revert. Apply/reapply use false, revert true. On returned status success it toggles named per-turn applied state; non-success result opens details; mutation rejection reports an error. ra/da disable actions when applying or !canApply. Root resolution, mutation receiver and real filesystem effects remain separate boundaries; no patch success or mode exclusion was observed.
evidence.method: frozen-source AST, lexical and exact ESM identity review; no target evaluation
